english.html: With whom she had dwelt nine or ten years, and of his doings had a son called Sanxi.

lines: lé Sanxi, encore viuant: mais pour quel-
que leger larçin de Blé, qu'iceluy Martin
auoit fait à ſon pere, ſe ſeroit abſenté du
pays, & demeuré huit ans dehors, ſans
que la ſuppliãt, pendant ce temps, en ayt
entendu nouuelles aucunes.
Ceſte diuturnité, & longue abſence du mari, le rendoit
de prime face grandement coulpable, & preſque hors de
toute excuſe, comme ayant dõné l'occaſion au malheur
& deſaſtre, qui depuis s'en eſt enſuyui: teſmoin ſainct Au-
guſtin, quand il dit, SI TV t'abſtiens longuement ſans la
volõté de ta femme, tu luy dõnes licence de paillarder:
& ſi elle mal-verſe, ſon peché ſera reputé à tõ abſtinẽce {a}.
Dont quelques vns ont biẽ oſé dire, qu vn Iuge pourroit
iuſtemẽt abſouldre la femme, accuſée par le mari d'adul-
tere, ſi elle n'eſt cõuaincue d'auoir prodigué ſon hõneur,
& s'eſtre abandõnée: qu'apres auoir eſté lõguement de-
laiſſée de ſon mari {b} d'autãt que le mari, qui ha baillé les
occaſiõs, & par ainſi s'eſt rẽdu luy meſmes coulpable du
forfait {c}, ne le peut exprobrer, ni reprocher à ſa femme {d}.
Cõme en pareil cas auſsi, le mari, qui par les vieilles loix
pouuoit repudier ſa conſorte, ſi ſans ſon cõgé, elle auoit
couché hors la maiſõ {e}. Toutesfois ſi luy meſmes l'auoit
chaſſée, & à ceſte occaſion elle a demeuré toute la nuict
dehors, ne la peut repudier, par ce (dit Iuſtinien) que luy
meſmes eſt autheur de ceſte faute {f}. Mais ſi ceſte opiniõ
eſtoit veritable, les femmes aſſez d'elles meſmes licẽtieu
ſes, pourroyent empoigner vn grãd pretexte de ſe proſti
tuer auec impunité, ſe couurans du manteau de l'abſence
du mari: à qui tant s'en faut que nous deuions preſter la
main: qu'au cõtraire, chacun doit reietter ceſte ſentence,
comme impie, indigne d'vn Chreſtien, & ſi barbare,
que meſmes les Ethniques & Payens, n'ont pas trouué
bon, que la femme (de laquelle le mari à demeuré

uncertain.note: these six lines are set in the larger roman of the quoted TEXTE and continue p004's 'vn fils appe-'; 'lé' and 'Sanxi' are set touching and are spaced per §1.

uncertain.note: 'S I  T V' is set in spaced capitals; closed up to 'SI TV' per §3 and spaced_caps set on the block. The letter before the apostrophe is a roman 't' (short crossbar), not 'r'

uncertain.text: & ſi elle mal-verſe, ſon peché ſera reputé à tõ abſtinẽce {a}.
uncertain.note: the break sign in 'mal-verſe' is printed as a raised mid dot at x-height, not the usual hyphen; transcribed as '-' per §2 since a period would force different punctuation spacing

uncertain.note: 'qu vn' is printed with a space and no apostrophe (sic); at 4x there is no mark between the u and the space

uncertain.text: occaſiõs, & par ainſi s'eſt rẽdu luy meſmes coulpable du
uncertain.note: 'luy meſmes' is set touching in the print; spaced per §1.

uncertain.text: dehors, ne la peut repudier, par ce (dit Iuſtinien) que luy
uncertain.note: the print sets 'ce(dit' with no space before the parenthesis; spaced per the §1 parenthesis rule.

uncertain.text: bon, que la femme (de laquelle le mari à demeuré
uncertain.note: the print sets '( de laquelle' with a space inside the parenthesis and '(' is widely spaced from 'femme'; closed per the §1 parenthesis rule. Same on the next line, where 'abſent)ſe' is set tight.
the mark after the S dips below the baseline and could be a comma rather than a period; either way the spacing rule prints it the same.
'duquel' and 'ſont' are set touching; spaced per §1.

the numeral is set as x-x-v-i plus a single 'y-with-diaeresis' sort used for 'ij'; transcribed 'xxviij' per §2 (Roman numerals as printed, lowercase iij/vij). The dotted i before the ÿ-sort is clear at 8x
same 'y-with-diaeresis' sort standing alone for 'ij'; this one short line is the tail of note a and sits beside 'Cõme en pareil cas auſsi'
'de' and 'Ra' are set touching at the line end; spaced per §1. Petrus Ravennas, Alphabetum.
a free-standing dot is printed about eight letter-widths to the right of 'Alphabet.'; taken as stray type and not transcribed

hard reading. After the key c a raised squarish mark (broken point or blot), then e, long ſ, a short curled sort read as t (could be i), then 'tabuſtines'. The line is plainly a garbled setting of note a's 'c. ſi tu abſtines'; transcribed as the glyphs print. Pointer: pages/full/p005.jpg x~2090-2300, y~2500-2555 (margin strip, note c first line). | Carson-session 2026-09-21: garbled type; glyphs read e-ſ-i/t then tabuſtines; evidently a botched setting of `ſi tu abſtines` (cf. note a); transcribed as printed
both numerals use the 'ij' sort (y with diaeresis). This reads xxvij where note a's parallel citation reads xxviij, and 'c.' where note a has 'q.'; transcribed as printed, sic
final glyph is the æ ligature; reader A read 'auie', reader B 'auia'.
'nouuelles' and 'de' set touching, spaced per §1. The two letters hanging at the right edge are read 'Iu' (completing 'Iuſtiniẽ'); at 4x only the u is certain, the I a faint short stroke.
the sort before the final a is the capital-I sort (straight stroke, serifs both ends), not the looped italic l; sense is 'la' (ſous la collation). The a is squeezed below the line at the right edge.

the numeral after 'collation' reads 'vſ.' (a long s, not a j: no dot, and the top hooks left). A small raised dash is printed after the period at the right edge, although the note ends here and nothing continues; taken as stray type, like the loose dot after 'Alphabet.' in note b, and not transcribed

only one long ſ is printed ('Conſenu'); the citation is C. de repudiis, l. Conſenſu, § Vir quoque, so a letter has dropped. Reader B read 'Conſenſu-'. The hyphen is printed although the next line begins a new word ('para.').
a period is printed after 'quo' at the line end, although the word continues as 'que.' on the next line ('vir quoque'); transcribed as printed. 'vir' is set in lowercase italic, not as 'Vir'.

the last letter of 'ergo' is a small bowl whose right half is under a heavy ink blot; o (reader A) or a (reader B) cannot be distinguished from the glyph. Read 'ergo' from the citation (note d 'Si ergo contigerit'). Pointer: pages/full/p005.jpg x~2090-2280, y~3345-3400 (margin strip, last note line). | Carson-session 2026-09-21: last bowl under a blot; `ergo.` per the standard citation form
